text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a regression where an inline snippet on the KB page is rendering as a broken anchor and the sample curl shows a 404. This started after the recent snippet refactor. Can someone triage quickly?
kevin: which page and snippet exactly? I can take a quick look.
maria: /kb/runtime/quickstart.md, section "caching examples". The snippet that used to link to gist://runtimes/cache-sample now points to gist://runtimes/cache-sample-v2 which 404s. Quick repro: open the page, click the small "View example" button -> 404.
ashwin: hmm, I ran the link scanner earlier and it flagged a shortlink rewrite but I didn't have cycles. Do we have the original gist id?
maria: original was gist.github.com/rdw/cache-sample (redirected previously). New ref was automated by the snippet-tooling job. I tried a local fix — changing the link to the canonical gist id fixes rendering. Patching would be one-line in the markdown.
sophie: please open a tiny PR and tag me for review. I can merge during quiet hours. Also pinging for i18n: if we update canonical id do we need to patch localized copies?
maria: good point — there are ja/ and es/ copies. I checked ja/quickstart.md and it refers to the old shortlink too. We should only change the source canonical file and run the localization sync, but if that's a blocker I'll open a follow-up issue.
ashwin: open a PR, include a short note in the description: "fix: restore canonical gist id for caching example to avoid 404" and add backport label to 1.2-docs if needed.
maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1486 — changed link in /kb/runtime/quickstart.md and updated the inline snippet tag. Patch:
```
- [View example](https://gist.github.com/rdw/cache-sample-v2)
+ [View example](https://gist.github.com/rdw/cache-sample)
```
kevin: thanks — quick sanity check: does the snippet-tooling CI rehydrate snippets from the gist? If so we should ensure it still has access.
sophie: docs-bot, any automated checks failed on that PR?
docs-bot: Automated check report: broken-link-scan -> FAILED (1 broken shortlink resolved), snippet-lint -> PASS, staging-preview -> SUCCESS. See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/status/1486
maria: adding checklist in description: [x] fix link, [ ] confirm localized sync, [ ] backport if needed, [ ] CR from @sophie or @kevin.
kevin: I'll do a quick CR tonight and leave comments if anything else. If localized copies still point at old shortlink we can trigger the localization sync job next sprint.
sophie: approved the change; left one nit about inline wording. @maria can you squash the commit and update PR title to include "kb:" prefix?
maria: done — updated PR title to "kb: fix caching example gist link (restore canonical id)" and squashed. Thanks all.
ashwin: moving this to the weekly triage board and adding label docs:hotfix. If localized sync is required we'll open a separate ticket and tag translations.
maria: thanks — closing the slack loop. If anyone sees other 404s from the refactor please drop them here or file issues. :thumbsup:
